messages:
Asha: Quick heads-up — Acme QBR slide pack needs the final health slide + renewal risk snapshot by tomorrow EOD. Can we centralize updates here so the deck owner (Priya) can pull?
Marcus: On it. I'll drop the usage trend + top-3 support tickets.
Priya: Thx — I'm collating. Can everyone confirm owner for the enablement ask? 
Jorge: I'll own enablement. Plan is: 1) onboarding completion % by cohort, 2) top blockers, 3) recommended next steps for training.
Marcus: Uploading raw numbers now: active seats 4,200 -> 4,450 MoM, avg latency hits on their integration spike last week.
Asha: Renewal risk quick note: CSM flagged exec attention on billing discrepancy and a delayed SSO rollout. Risk = medium, action: exec intro + billing ticket resolution.
Olivia: Can we include a single-line exec ask on slide 2: "Decision: approve billing credit & SSO timeline"? that'll help the sponsor meeting. :+1:
Priya: Love that wording. Also need a one-sentence customer quote for the success highlights. Any recent wins?
Jorge: They shipped the search feature using embeddings — 32% improved accuracy per their QA. Snag: we still have one integration test failing.
Marcus: Adding support ticket IDs: #5421 (SSO), #5489 (billing). ETA for fix: billing patch by Tue, SSO vendor escalated.
Asha: Converting into slide checklist for Priya to copy: 
```
- Health snapshot: MRR trend, adoption by team, top incidents (IDs)
- Renewal risk: reason(s), mitigation owner + ETA
- Enablement: onboarding %, blockers, next steps
- Exec ask: 1-line decision + proposed timeline
- Quote: 1 short customer quote with attribution
```
Priya: I'm patching those into the deck now. If you can paste the ticket links + a short quote, I'll slot them into the one-pager.
Marcus: Ticket links: https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/5421, https://support.redwood.ai/ticket/5489. Quote from Acme PM: "Search accuracy has noticeably improved — team adoption accelerating."
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline in 18 hours. Upload final PPT to /shared/qbrs/Acme/ by 09:00 tomorrow.
Asha: Sweet — I'll follow up with billing lead to fast-track the credit. Priya, ping me if you need the exec note rewritten.
Priya: Will do. Thanks everyone — I should have v1 in the folder in the next 2 hours. :calendar:
